job_description: Analyze datasets, write SQL queries, clean data with Python and Excel, build Power BI or Tableau dashboards, and communicate insights using statistics.
Use Python, SQL, statistics, machine learning, Pandas, NumPy, and Scikit-learn to analyze data, build predictive models, and communicate findings.
Develop and deploy machine learning systems using Python, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch, and deep learning techniques.
Build natural language processing applications using Python, text preprocessing, machine learning, deep learning, and NLP frameworks.
Build data pipelines, process structured data using Python and SQL, and work with cloud platforms, databases, and data infrastructure.
Create business reports and interactive dashboards using SQL, Excel, Power BI, or Tableau to support data-driven decisions.
